description: This PHP class defines a controller named ViewEmailConfigurationController within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for handling email configuration view logic. It extends an abstract Vue controller, uses a configuration service trait, and prepares a Vue component with email sendmail path for rendering.

classes.name: ViewEmailConfigurationController
classes.description: Controller for viewing email configuration, extending AbstractVueController, sets up Vue component with email sendmail path.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with email sendmail path before rendering, utilizing configuration service to fetch path.
